{{Quote|Echo Base! This is Echo Station 3-4. We are being overrun! I say again: Walkers are overrunning this position! Will withdraw to Station 2-4 immediately. Do you copy, Echo Ba&hellip;|A Rebel trooper|<ref name="AoH" />}} 
'''Echo Station 3-4''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] post that was situated at the perimeter of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], located on the ice-[[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It was attacked during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="AoH" />
